cases.reason: Preserves that the assistant reported, rather than established, the five-year Zephyr QX-100 warranty and that the assistant has not verified the report. English matches the requested language.
Changes an explicitly unverified report by the assistant into an asserted verified warranty, reversing verification status and removing attribution.
Preserves both attribution levels: Ada relays that Bo said the inspection is free. Also preserves that Ada has not checked Bo’s statement. English matches the requested language.
Reverses the speakers: the source has Ada relaying Bo’s statement, while the candidate has Bo attributing the statement to Ada.

Turns the hypothetical six-week rule and conditional violation into real requirements and an actual violation, contradicting the explicit statement that the real rule is unknown.

Reverses the component scope: the source proposes one rotary control knob and excludes the whole panel, whereas the candidate proposes the whole panel and excludes one knob.
Preserves Ada as the person who does not know and this note as the evidence that establishes neither inclusion nor exclusion. English matches the request.

Broadens Ada’s lack of knowledge to nobody and changes the evidentiary subject from this note to a contract. A note establishing neither inclusion nor exclusion does not imply that the contract says nothing.
